components.name: Aggregates
components.description: A physical source file with its extraction state, authority classification and citable passages.

components.name: `Document.record_extraction`
components.description: A second call on the same Document raises `AlreadyExtracted`; tier and quality are unchanged after reclassification attempt

components.name: Extraction quality gate
components.description: A document with confidence below threshold yields `DocumentQuarantined` and `publishable_passages()` returns `[]`

components.name: `Passage.offsets`
components.description: Constructing offsets outside the parent article bounds raises; over-investigation guard: overlapping siblings rejected

components.name: `SpeakerKind` classification
components.description: A person-attributed quotation produces `PersonalQuotationExcluded` and never reaches `publishable_passages()`; an institution-attributed statement remains citable

components.name: `ExtractDocumentText`
components.description: A scanned PDF without text layer routes to OCR and yields non-empty text with `quality.method == "ocr"`

components.name: `SegmentArticle`
components.description: A 3-clipping digest yields exactly 3 articles with distinct headlines and page ranges

components.name: Provenance resolution
components.description: `GET /api/v1/passages/{id}` returns outlet, date, page and offsets that reproduce the exact text slice from the source file

components.name: `ClassifySourceAuthority`
components.description: Unknown source type is refused (`SourceTypeUnknown`); a press report never outranks a statute for a legal claim type

components.name: `LinkCanonicalArticle`
components.description: Two identical texts link to one canonical article; citation counts do not double

components.name: `PinCorpusSnapshot`
components.description: Snapshot pins documents + index version; re-running ingestion afterwards does not change passages visible through the old snapshot

components.name: `IndexIngestedPassages`
components.description: Passages are searchable via `tsvector` within the same application run; re-indexing is idempotent

components.name: API contract
components.description: All endpoints appear in generated OpenAPI and return the documented envelope; error paths use `{code,message,details,trace_id}`
